messages:
maria: Canary flagged p95 spike after release v1.14.3 — rollback blocked by approval, creating thread to collate bisect + CI noise notes
perf-bot: CI perf check failed: latency_regression_test p95 +35% (threshold 15%). Build 8921 — see /ci/artifacts/8921/summary.json
aj: I started a local bisect, saw spike only when matmul_v3_q4 kernel used + kvcache enabled.
liam: interesting — do we have traces?
dmitri: uploaded a flamegraph: https://internal.storage/runs/8921/flame.svg — shows long stalls in `kv_eviction_loop` between 120-140ms per token
sre-chantal: infra: the GPU host had slightly elevated IO but within SLA. ran a clean node and replicated the failure there too. not a noisy-host OOS.
aj: repro snippet: ```./bench --suite=latency_regression --model=redwood-3b-q4 --kvcache=on --kernel=auto --seq_len=1024```
maria: when I pin kernel to `matmul_v2` the spike disappears. `matmul_v3_q4` + kvcache seems to cause cache churn with our batching heuristic.
liam: hypothesis: batching groups requests that cause KV cache eviction thrash — matmul_v3_q4 has larger working set and triggers more swaps at the same batch sizes.
dmitri: microbench numbers: kv cache hit-rate dropped from 94% -> 62% under matmul_v3_q4 at seq_len=1024. raw log line: `kv_cache_stats hits=620 misses=380 total=1000`. also saw GPU memcpy spikes in the profile.
aj: proposal: tighten CI p95 threshold from 15% -> 12% and add a focused matrix test for kernel+kv combinations. also add deterministic runner node pinning to reduce host noise in perf runs.
maria: also propose harness change: run each perf case N=7 times and use median p95 to reduce flakiness instead of single-shot. avoid adding manual exemptions to release flow.
sre-chantal: will add pinning label to perf-runner and a flag to force `--kernel=matmul_v2` in canary if needed. also marking `matmul_v3_q4` as opt-in until we fix memory accounting.
liam: I'll open a PR: `perf/harness: add kernel_kv matrix + median-of-n logic + kv_cache_stats artifact` with test cases for seq_len (256,512,1024) and batch (1,4,8).
eng-release-bot: Created rollout hold RH-2219: "latency regression detected in canary — investigation in progress"
maria: next steps: aj to finish bisect for commits between 1.14.2..1.14.3 and check for kernel-selection heuristic changes; liam to draft harness PR; chantal to pin runners and re-run canary with pinned kernel. sync in 2h.
aj: on it — started bisect, current suspect commit 4567bde (kernel-selection: heuristics tuned for latency over kv footprint). will post bisect commits as I go.
dmitri: uploading CPU/GPU profiles to the artifact bucket now. quick repro image: `redwood/perf-debug:kv-batch-2026` pushed to internal registry.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup: keep notes here and paste links to PRs/ARTs.
